rules.rule: When organizing many items with AI, automatically chunk the workload to avoid context-window limits and process in batches.
evidence: D1:1: "I have a ton of notes and I want to use AI to auto organize them into folders for me  Basically if they are currently unorganized, AI needs to put them in an existing folder or create a new folder for it  Iff the number of notes is too much or pass the context window AI should chunk the requests for me. I should be able to preview the folders   And then, I should also be able to drag and drop notes that I dont like the folder to move it into a different folder if I dont like what AI did. So that means I can remove items from folders and add items to folders via drag and drop.   And then I would like to have a feature that allows me to chat with AI so I can ask it a question and it can ground the answer in a note I have and even find it for me, find a particular note. It should locate and ground the context in two steps — first figuring out the relevant folders it might be in, and then returning the notes in those folders and using that as the basis of their answer. And the thinking of that needs to be surfaced to the user, ie which folders it selected, and which notes is looking through. And the chatbot should answer my question and link me to the notes that are relevant to my topic. Like I click the button in the chatbot and it will bring me to the note that it is referencing. The chatbot needs to be grounded in evidence"
